title: Left-Quillen transport and comparison of special simplicial frames
statement: Use the model-category axioms and Reedy structures of [lem-coef-reedy-model-structure]. Let $T:\mathcal M\rightleftarrows\mathcal N:U$ be an adjunction whose left functor preserves cofibrations and trivial cofibrations. Let $Y_c$ be cofibrant and fibrant. Let $B:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal M$ be Reedy fibrant with $B_0=Y_c$ and a Reedy trivial cofibration $i:\operatorname{const}Y_c\to B$ with $i_0=1_{Y_c}$. Let $r:TY_c\to Z$ be a trivial cofibration with $Z$ fibrant. Let $B':\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal N$ be Reedy fibrant with $B'_0=Z$ and an objectwise weak-equivalence coaugmentation $i':\operatorname{const}Z\to B'$ with $i'_0=1_Z$. Then $T(i):\operatorname{const}(TY_c)\to TB$ is a Reedy trivial cofibration. There exists a natural transformation $b:TB\to B'$ satisfying $bT(i)=i'\operatorname{const}(r)$ and $b_0=r$, and every component of $b$ is a weak equivalence.

source.place: Hovey, Model Categories, Theorem 5.2.8 (printed p.128), Proposition 5.4.7 (p.132), Lemma 5.5.1 (p.133); agent extraction of the Reedy lifting and comparison argument in the parent former step 12.
